fire.title: Fire explotion overlay!
fire.usage: One silent burst after a failed submission. Screen blending removes black; an elliptical mask keeps the centre clear. UI limits visibility to 3000 ms at one-third playback speed.

jokes.assignment: One fixed joke for each of 15 tasks, shared by that task's independent variants.
jokes.editing: Short traditional jokes; punctuation normalized and some versions shortened. Each item links to its source.
